units.source_text: 只有一人无牵无挂，那就是大竹二世。

en.t: Only one person was free of cares, and that was Otake the Second.

units.source_text: 他是八个月的初生婴儿，长得确实俊秀，令人感到要是有人问大竹七段的精神如何，只需看看这个婴儿就一目了然。

en.t: He was an eight-month-old infant, truly handsome, and he made one feel that if anyone asked what the spirit of Otake seventh dan was like, they need only look at this baby to understand at once.

units.source_text: 这个婴儿俊极了，简直是七段的精神象征。

en.t: This baby was extraordinarily handsome, almost the very symbol of the seventh dan's spirit.

units.source_text: 我今天无论看到哪个成年人都觉得难受，唯独看见这个桃太郎，却使我得到一点慰藉，仿佛顿时得救了似的。

en.t: Today, no matter which adult I looked at, I felt distressed, but seeing this little Momotaro alone gave me a measure of comfort, as though I had suddenly been saved.
